notes.bytes: All strings are raw bytes; lengths and offsets are byte-based, NUL and invalid UTF-8 are preserved.
notes.errors: Catalog failures use RUN_HOST; file failures use FUNCTION: PATH: OS reason.
notes.lifetime: Default registries own standard collection lifetimes; handles are valid only for the active run. All collection types share a 65536-object allocation budget; clearing a collection does not reclaim an allocation.
notes.paths: Relative file paths use the process cwd without sandbox or root checks. Unix preserves native path bytes; Windows requires strict UTF-8 and supports long drive/UNC paths. Every platform rejects embedded NUL. Symlinks are followed; missing/broken paths and nonregular objects return false from file_exists, while other metadata errors trap.
notes.registration: Default registries install 206 built-ins; testing print/assertions remain explicit host registrations. Return-sink imports are host-bound and write only to an invocation-owned sink.
notes.json: Json is immutable strict UTF-8 JSON: scalar Unicode, signed int64 or finite binary64, depth 256, duplicate decoded keys/BOM rejected. Compact output preserves number/string token spellings; navigation borrows nodes until run end.
notes.priority: PQ is min-first with insertion-order ties; signed zero priorities tie. Nonfinite priorities and next sequence 2^63-1 fail without mutation; clear resets sequence to zero.
notes.encoding: Hex is lowercase on encode and accepts ASCII mixed-case digits on decode. Base64 is canonical padded RFC 4648 section 4, rejecting whitespace, URL-safe alphabet, invalid padding and nonzero pad bits. Strings are raw bytes.
notes.snapshots: Map keys()/values() each allocate one independent list snapshot in insertion order; mutation never aliases map storage. Float payload bits are preserved.
notes.templates: One-pass text rendering with nested JSON context, zero-based indexed lists, list loops and strict boolean conditions. Strings insert verbatim; other values use compact JSON. No recursive interpolation or format-specific escaping.
notes.results: The invocation-owned ResultSink is external to arenas and retains owned writes across body/entry calls. JSON values use strict UTF-8, safe mathematical integers (±9007199254740991), finite binary64 and shortest-round-trip formatting; explicit successful host framing follows dispatch and application validation.
